game.title: Tap Garden
game.tagline: Tap the pot, grow dew, merge your way to the Golden World Tree

buttons.tapPot: Tap the magic pot to collect dew

offline.title: Welcome back!
offline.body: Your garden kept dripping dew while you were away.

celebrate.title: Golden World Tree!
celebrate.body: You grew the legendary Golden World Tree. The garden keeps growing — enjoy!

reset.title: Reset progress?
reset.body: This clears your garden, dew and upgrades. It cannot be undone.

a11y.help: Tap the pot to collect dew. Buy seeds, then tap a plant to select it and tap a matching plant to merge them into the next level. Tap an empty plot to move a selected plant. Keys: arrow keys move between plots, Enter or Space select and act, T taps the pot, B buys a seed, U upgrades tap power.
a11y.full: The garden is full or you need more dew.
a11y.titleDemo: Title screen: the garden is playing itself.
